name: concord
description: Contract-level coherence, live worktree inspection, and smart merging for parallel AI coding agents.
long_description: Concord coordinates parallel AI coding agents (OpenCode or Claude Code) and verifies merges at the symbol/contract level across Python, TypeScript/JS, Rust, and Go. Exposes contract-only symbol maps, contract diffs, live git-worktree inspection, contract-verified smart merging with SASE Merge-Readiness Packs, and full multi-agent orchestration.

tools.name: concord_symbols
tools.description: List symbol contracts and line spans without function bodies (Python, TS/JS, Rust, Go)

tools.name: concord_diff_contracts
tools.description: Compare revisions or working tree at contract level with impacted callers

tools.name: concord_analyze
tools.description: Check branches for cross-file contract breaks, duplicate symbols, and merge conflicts

tools.name: concord_worktrees
tools.description: Inspect all active git worktrees in memory for contract and region conflicts

tools.name: concord_smart_merge
tools.description: Merge branches in producer-first contract order with verified insertion union and bisection

tools.name: concord_negotiate
tools.description: Propose a contract change to the live agent holding a symbol lease

tools.name: concord_ack
tools.description: Explicitly acknowledge a peer's published contract update

tools.name: concord_plan
tools.description: Partition the repository symbol graph into conflict-aware parallel ticket clusters

tools.name: concord_run
tools.description: Start a team of parallel coding agents coordinated live by Concord

tools.name: concord_status
tools.description: Progress of a Concord run, or the list of runs

tools.name: concord_result
tools.description: Final report, SASE Merge-Readiness Pack, and integration branch of a finished run
